accounts.name: voter_stake
docs: Voter must have MYR staked; their stake weight is used as the vote weight.

accounts.name: vote_record
docs: One-time-use PDA proving this (voter, proposal) pair hasn't voted yet.
`init` fails if it already exists — this is the double-vote guard.

accounts.name: reserve_vault
docs: Optional reserve vault — if present, 5% of premium is routed there as backstop.
Initialize via `initialize_reserve` before calling this instruction.

accounts.name: proposer_stake
docs: Proposer must have MYR staked — prevents spam from wallets with no skin in the game.

accounts.name: pool
docs: Pool whose config is being updated. Decoded from action_payload.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone can call (keeper/cron incentive)

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless — anyone can finalize after the delay expires.

accounts.name: reserve_vault
docs: PDA-owned token account — pool PDA is the SPL authority so it can sign
withdrawals via `finalize_payout`.

accounts.name: oracle_authority
docs: Primary oracle authority — must match pool_config.oracle_authority

accounts.name: secondary_oracle
docs: Optional second signer for 2-of-3 multi-sig. Must be in the multisig signer list
and different from oracle_authority. Required when oracle_multisig_config.threshold >= 2.

accounts.name: oracle_multisig_config
docs: Optional multisig config — when present enforces threshold signing.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless — anyone can queue a payout once conditions are met.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless — anyone can queue a passed proposal.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless — anyone can execute a payout once a valid oracle report exists.
USDC always goes to policy.policyholder, so front-running is harmless.

accounts.name: oracle_report
docs: Oracle report posted by the oracle that was authoritative when this policy was created.
Validates against policy.trigger_condition.oracle_pubkey — not the current pool config —
so oracle authority rotation cannot retroactively break in-force policies.
Seeds: [b"oracle_report", pool.key(), policy.trigger_condition.scope_hash]

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must be the pool authority

errors.name: PoolNotActive

errors.name: WithdrawalExceedsAvailable
errors.msg: Withdrawal exceeds available liquidity

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Unauthorized

errors.name: InsufficientPremium
errors.msg: Premium is below the pool's minimum floor

errors.name: CoverageCapExceeded
errors.msg: Coverage cap exceeded: pool cannot accept more locked exposure

errors.name: OracleReportStale
errors.msg: Oracle report is stale — must be posted within the validity window

errors.name: OracleReportBeforePolicy
errors.msg: Oracle report was posted before this policy was created

errors.name: OracleScopeMismatch
errors.msg: Oracle report scope does not match this policy

errors.name: InvalidConfig

errors.name: TimelockNotExpired

errors.name: OracleReportNotNewer

errors.name: LockNotExpired
errors.msg: Stake lock period has not yet expired

errors.name: ProposalNotPassed
errors.msg: Proposal voting has not passed (insufficient votes or not ended)

errors.name: InvalidActionType
errors.msg: Invalid action type for proposal execution

errors.name: ProposalNotQueued
errors.msg: Proposal must be queued through the timelock before execution

errors.name: PayoutVetoed
errors.msg: Payout has been vetoed by the pool authority

errors.name: PayoutDelayPassed
errors.msg: Payout delay window has already passed; veto no longer possible

errors.name: MultisigThresholdNotMet
errors.msg: Oracle multisig threshold not met — required signers missing or unauthorized

errors.name: InvalidTranche
errors.msg: Invalid tranche — must be 0 (junior), 1 (mezzanine), or 2 (senior)

errors.name: InsufficientTrancheLiquidity
errors.msg: Insufficient tranche liquidity for withdrawal

errors.name: DemoModeDisabled
errors.msg: Instant payout is disabled — use queue_payout for the 48-hour verified flow

types.name: OracleAuthorityProposal
docs: Pending oracle authority change. Created by `propose_oracle_authority`,
applied by `apply_oracle_authority` after ORACLE_TIMELOCK_SECS.

fields.name: signers
docs: Up to 3 authorized oracle signers

fields.name: threshold
docs: Minimum number of signers required to post a report (1–3)

fields.name: authority
docs: Must match pool_config.oracle_authority — only this keypair can post reports

fields.name: pool
docs: Which pool this report is for

fields.name: scope_hash
docs: Domain-specific risk scope. Multiple regions/assets/gauges can share a pool
without sharing the same latest oracle report.

fields.name: reported_value
docs: The verified oracle value (e.g. rainfall mm, delay minutes, TVL in USD)

fields.name: reported_at
docs: Unix timestamp when this report was posted

fields.name: description
docs: Human-readable description of the verified event (for audit trail)

fields.name: min_premium_bps
docs: Minimum premium in basis points of payout amount (e.g. 500 = 5%)

fields.name: max_coverage_bps
docs: Maximum coverage ratio in basis points of total_liquidity (e.g. 8000 = 80%)

fields.name: reserve_balance
docs: Running total of USDC held in the reserve vault (informational; canonical source is the vault balance)

fields.name: demo_mode
docs: When true, trigger_payout (instant, no delay) is permitted — for demo/testnet use only.
Production pools should set this to false; real claims go through queue_payout → finalize_payout.

fields.name: scope_hash
docs: Domain-specific risk scope, such as region/gauge/asset/route hash.
Payouts require an oracle report posted for the same scope.

types.name: VoteRecord
docs: One account per (voter, proposal) pair — prevents double voting.
Created by `cast_vote`; its existence proves the voter already voted.
